title: Multi-Trade Service Contracts: Keep HubSpot Renewal Dates and Acumatica Contract Status Aligned
summary: Keep MEP renewal opportunities aligned with the actual contract term, covered sites and approved service status.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


HubSpot–Acumatica two-way sync for multi-trade service contracts should distinguish a sales renewal opportunity from an active service agreement. Acumatica-owned contract status and dates can inform HubSpot renewal work; sales-owned contacts and negotiation context can inform the approved handoff. Preserve the contract identifier and term version so a future renewal does not overwrite current coverage. Validate the actual contract entities and fields in the Acumatica environment before enabling their writes.


Explore the complete[commercial HVAC, plumbing and electrical contractors integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction/commercial-mep-contractors) for the systems and processes around this guide.
